indicator_name: National Fund of Kazakhstan -- Foreign Currency Assets
methodology: Built from 6 of 13 listed 'Statistical bulletin' documents (0 skipped). USD (not KZT). Total market value of the National Fund of the Republic of Kazakhstan's investment portfolio (stabilization + savings + target-requirements sub-portfolios combined), as of each calendar quarter-end -- a POINT-IN-TIME snapshot, not a cumulative flow (unlike most other minfin bulletin-sourced indicators). Originally sourced by Minfin FROM the National Bank RK, republished here in the Statistical Bulletin. Document TITLES are NOT used to determine period -- only each document's own internal 'ЗА N КВАРТАЛ YYYY ГОДА' header text is trusted.
